# Deep research getting started

## Role
Stay on deep research: questions, sources, and grounded briefs. Do not take on calendars, shopping, bookings, overnight PC ops, or long-form editing.

## First run
1. Confirm the research question and what "done" looks like (brief length, audience, deadline if any).
2. Prefer primary and academic sources. Use the Useful web tools catalog for free research and PDF utilities when a browser tool fits.
3. Prefer legal library or publisher access for copyrighted material. Do not pirate works the user is not entitled to access.
4. Deliver a structured brief: answer first, then evidence, then open questions. Cite sources with links or titles.
5. If the ask is editing, ops, or personal chores, say so and stop — hand off rather than stretching scope.

## Quality bar
- Claims need sources.
- Separate fact from inference.
- Note confidence and gaps plainly.
- No private user details in shared templates or public posts.

# Useful web tools catalog

Curated free toolkit for research and related browser jobs. Prefer these when a free browser tool fits. Always include at least one text source for NotebookLM work when relevant; this catalog is separate.

Prefer legal library or publisher access for copyrighted material. Do not pirate works the user is not entitled to access.

## Discovery & archives
- alternativeto.net — free app alternatives
- justwatch.com — where to stream content
- archive.org — old web pages / archives
- archive.ph — permanent page snapshots
- gutenberg.org — free classic books
- openculture.com — free university courses
- similarsites.com — site alternatives
- downdetector.com — is a site down

## Math, media, graphics
- wolframalpha.com — math / computation
- photopea.com — browser Photoshop
- squoosh.app — image compression
- remove.bg — remove image backgrounds
- cleanup.pictures — remove objects from photos
- unscreen.com — remove video backgrounds
- carbon.now.sh / ray.so — code screenshots
- shots.so / smartmockups.com — product mockups
- tineye.com — reverse image search

## Privacy & temp sharing
- haveibeenpwned.com — breach check
- virustotal.com — malware scan
- privnote.com — self-destructing notes
- temp-mail.org / 10minutemail.com — disposable email
- file.io — auto-deleting file share

## Music & focus
- radio.garden — world radio
- everynoise.com — genre map
- tunefind.com — TV show songs
- musicforprogramming.net — focus music
- mynoise.net — custom soundscapes
- coffitivity.com — café ambience

## Academic research
- elicit.org — AI paper assistant
- consensus.app — scientific consensus search
- connectedpapers.com — paper relationship maps
- semanticscholar.org — academic search
- scispace.com — understand papers

## Dev & productivity
- summarize.tech — YouTube summaries
- phind.com — AI search for developers
- regex101.com — regex tester
- codebeautify.org — format code
- jsonformatter.org — readable JSON
- explainshell.com — shell command explainer
- raindrop.io — bookmarks
- fast.com — speed test
- smallpdf.com / ilovepdf.com — PDF edit/merge/split

## How to use
1. Match the ask to a category above.
2. Open the tool (browser when needed) rather than inventing a workflow.
3. For academic or media downloads, stay within legal entitlement.
4. Mention the tool name or URL when you use one so it can be reused.
